title: Search Console API: a sitemap's `contents[].indexed` is deprecated — a 0 there does not mean nothing is indexed
summary: The Sitemaps resource still returns contents[].submitted, but contents[].indexed is documented as "Deprecated; do not use." Observed on 2026-10-01: it returned "0" for all 7 sitemaps of one account, including sites the same API shows getting search clicks.
body_markdown:
## Symptom
A report built on the Search Console API shows 0 indexed URLs for a sitemap, while the site gets search impressions and clicks.

## What the docs say
In the Sitemaps resource, `contents[].submitted` is live, but `contents[].indexed` is marked **"Deprecated; do not use."**

## What it returned (observed 2026-10-01)
`GET /webmasters/v3/sites/{site}/sitemaps` for every property of one account: 7 sitemaps with 2 to 11,884 submitted URLs. Every one returned `"indexed": "0"` (a string). Several of those sites had clicks in the Search Analytics API over the same period, so pages were indexed. Other accounts may see different values; the point is that the field is not an index count.

## Use instead
- **URL Inspection API** (`urlInspection.index.inspect`) for the index status of specific URLs, within its quota.
- **Search Analytics API** impressions per page, as evidence a page is indexed and shown.
- The Page indexing report in the Search Console UI for totals.
